Scourge of the Dreadmire is a bone wraith summoned by Zel'han the Summoner during The Problem with Containing a Death Loa.

Scout Khenyug is a centaur located in a watch tower at the southwestern entrance to Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. As part of Khansguard Jebotai's war orders, he tells Khenyug to be on the lookout for Nokhud incursions. Khenyug, who's already lost several scouts to Nokhud ambushes, declares that she'll make the Nokhud pay for every scout they kill. __NOTOC__

Scout Tomul is a centaur of Clan Shikaar encountered as a quest giver throughout the Ohn'ahran Plains. Although a good hunter, Tomul's most notable trait is her keen eyesight, which makes her an excellent scout for Sansok Khan. She is the first centaur encountered by players in the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline, but she is irritable and resents having to serve as the two-foots' "keeper". Tomul also oversees Grand Hunts, and can be seen alongside Trainer Frodrum and racks of Hunting Equipment wherever the event is currently taking place.
Scout Santuun is a centaur located in Emerald Gardens and the Mane Squeeze in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She wants to get to know the local dryads.
Scout Kuvaeth is a nightborne located just south of the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores. He and a few Beleaguered Explorers are found standing around a dead Displaced Earth.
Scorpion Slicer is a quest reward from Legacy of Tyr: Secrets of the Past.
Scout Watu is a centaur located in Pinewood Post in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The Scourge Enclosure is found at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak. The enormous cage keeps Gymer imprisoned.
Scourge Zombies are zombies located on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
__NOTOC__ Scout Francisco is a Forsaken located in the Waking Shores.

A scroll is an item that must be read in order to be used. Most scrolls have some sort of buff effect that applies to the selected target, but some just have a message. The buff from a affects all party and raid members, while other scroll buffs only affect a single target. Scroll buffs do not stack with player buffs that affect the same stat, or with other scroll buffs. As of Cataclysm they also count as ether Battle or Guardian Elixirs. Players with the Inscription profession are able to create their own scrolls using Ink and Parchment, with the exception of Scrolls of Protection, which are only available as loot, from vendors, and, in some cases, in quest rewards. The Scrimshaw Dagger is a dagger that gives a bonus to stamina.
The Screeching Canyon was a canyon in the southern parts of Thousand Needles infested by aggressive Screeching harpies. The Roguefeather Den was located in the back of it.

The Screaming Gully is the first large chamber encountered beyond the instance portal in the Wailing Caverns. The Fanglord Lady Anacondra is usually found here along with a bevy of Deviate raptors and Druids of the Fang. The ancient turtle Kresh paces throught he shallow water at the bottom of the Gully.
Screeching Bow is a Level 48 quality Bow which improves Agility, Stamina and Haste.
Screaming Dagger is a quest reward from Felspark Ravine (quest) and The Path of Anguish (quest).
Scratching Sticks are obtained by pickpocketing some low level humanoids such as the gnolls of the Mosshide tribe.

The Scraggy Leather Armor Set items are random drops in the Blood Elf beginning area, Sunstrider Isle and Falthrien Academy. It is equivalent to the Ragged Leather collection world drop for beginning areas, but lacks a cape in the set. This quality gear is actually very nice in the starting levels.

The Scrapyard is a subzone of Ulduar located in the outside part of the instance. XT-002 Deconstructor resides within here.

The Screeching are a group of blue-plumaged harpies found residing in Screeching Canyon in the Thousand Needles. They storage their foodstuffs in the depths of their lair. Some time after the Cataclysm, four screeching harpies attacked Freewind Post. One of them snatched a tauren named Corewind, but Thalia Amberhide rescued him. They were attacking it irregularly, every three or four days. They are also present at the Cliffroost in Suramar on the Broken Isles.
The Scribe's Quill is a quest reward from Piece of the Past.
Scraps of Rotting Meat is provided by Nolen Tacker for How to Make Meat Fresh Again.

Scratchfever is a cat that wanders along the road between Orgrimmar and Razor Hill with his master, Tednug. Although he is a Pet and shouldn't speak, when Tednug and him pass along some harpies on the canyon leading to Orgrimmar, both of them say, "Later."

Scrap Metal Pauldrons is a quest reward from Venture Company Mining (Horde).

Screamslash is a large dark blue raptor living along the Southfury River, next to the Southfury Watershed in Durotar. He patrols the peninsula north of Zen'Taji. He is considered to be 'The Terror of the Watershed'. According to Zen'Taji, the raptor has been killing many small animals and leaving them to rot, and could seriously disrupt the balance of nature in the area if left alone. His death is required for That's the End of That Raptor.
Scribe Rinji is a pandaren inscription trainer found in Greenstone Village in the Jade Forest.
Scroll of Introduction is provided by Foreman Raike to be delivered to Elder Sage Rain-Zhu for The Temple of the Jade Serpent.

Scritch is a rare hozen that appears in one of the caves near the Dooker Dome in Kun-Lai Summit. He is a Pandarian champion.

Scrivener Lenua is a venthyr who sometimes appears high above the Forbidden Library in Revendreth. When she spawns, Forbidden Tomes are scattered throughout the area and must be returned to the library. Lenua will come down and become attackable after four Forbidden Tomes are returned; the current count can be seen at the top of the screen.

The Screaming Anvil is Painsmith Raznal's workshop in the eastern, mid-level Sanctum of Domination, accessible by taking the central stair from the Torment Chambers and heading north through the Black Bellows. The chamber consists of a platform divided into squares from which spikes erupt during Raznal's encounter, suspended with chains over a pool of lava and overlooked by a raised platform where Raznal forges his instruments. After the Painsmith is defeated on non-Raid Finder difficulties, a gate opens up on the Screaming Anvil's western side, allowing access to an elevator that takes players up to the Crown of Gorgoa.

The Scuttle Coast is on the east coast of Durotar, looking out to the Great Sea. It is southeast of Razor Hill and north of Tiragarde Keep. The coast was littered with ships from Kul Tiras, smashed upon the rocks as a result of the great battles fought between the orcs and Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's fleet. During the Cataclysm, a large tidal wave swept the region, washing many of the sunken ships ashore. Angry sea elementals brought in by the tide now roam the beach, attacking those that come near. A sea lion is a saber-toothed aquatic mammal. Druids who have gained the Travel Form spell and use it in water can transform into this shape. The Druids of the Fin are a group of druids who specialize in sea lion form. Coastal Defenders are druids that transformed into this form during the War of the Thorns.

Se'Jib is a jungle troll leatherworking trainer located just south across the river from Mizjah Ruins in Northern Stranglethorn. During the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, Se'Jib traveled to the Trueshot Lodge of the Unseen Path.

The Sea Turtle is an aquatic/land mount that improves swim speed by 60% normally, and by 300% if the rider has Sea Legs in Vashj'ir. She provides no speed bonus on land and does not scale with riding skill. The Sea Turtle was the first official aquatic mount in the game, and currently the second of two amphibious aquatic mounts, the first being the Riding Turtle.

Scrolls of Lore was a fansite which offered forums to discuss Warcraft and its lore. The site was created in 2005 and has since grown to over 1000 members from across the globe. Its members regularly attend such events as live chats, as with Christie Golden and Richard A. Knaak, or Omacron's attendance and interview at BlizzCon. The moderators function in the absence of the old administrators, and include Timolas, Cantus, Aldrius, and Yuber8900. Nonetheless, Warlock maintains absolute control, and Keithjr manages the technical upkeep of the site. As of January 2022, the site went offline.

The Scullery in Karazhan lies beyond the Livery Stables. It is the tower's kitchens, and leads directly into the Banquet Hall. Remants of the scullery's foodstuffs remain, rotting in the neglect of its ghostly denizens. Before the Scullery, there is Bennett, the Sergeant of Arms. Near him there is a locked door that leads to the "Sergeant's Quarter" but the use of it is unknown. There is also a "Blood Covered Door" that contains Prince Tenris Mirkblood for the second Scourge Invasion event.

.]] Sea serpents are large serpents living in the seas of Azeroth. The sea serpents made their first appearance in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm in the Kelp'thar Forest of Vashj'ir. They shouldn't be confused with the gigantic eels that also roam the areas. The venom of the murkscale strikers of the Krasarang Wilds causes a potentially deadly condition that the locals call "the murksweats". They don't usually migrate as far north as Durotar, as a general rule. There is one known sea serpent on Argus, Slithon the Last in Eredath.

The Seabreach Flow is a river flowing from the sea to the west draining into River's Heart at the center of Sholazar Basin. The ship that Hemet Nesingwary's expedition came in on is strewn along its path from the seawall to the Nesingwary Base Camp and the flow is full of crocolisks as well.
Scroll of Recall II is created with Inscription (200); taught by trainers.
Scrooge is related to the seasonal world event, the Feast of Winter Veil. Completing this achievement is a criterion for the meta-achievement Merrymaker.

Scroll of Recall III is the 3rd and final in the Scroll of Recall series. Effectively, the scroll functions as a one-time use hearthstone. You may only use one Scroll of Recall every 20 minutes.

The Sea's Castle is the name of a ship belonging to the Bloodsail Buccaneers. It is captained by Quentin Bandor — a former student of architecture — and is the envy of other pirates, as he applied his architectural know-how to modify his ship into a comfortable and terrifying war machine.
Seas are large bodies of water found on the different worlds and planes.
The Scythe of Antiok is the scythe of Grand Necrolord Antiok. It allowed him to control frost wyrms. This item appears after killing Antiok in Dragonblight.

Seabrush is a coral reef north of Korthun's End and directly above Tenebrous Cavern in Abyssal Depths. This reef is teeming with life including crabs, fish, jellyfish, sharks, eels, sea turtles, rays and remoras. The Horde has laid claim to this area. Seabrush bottom.jpg

Sea Mist Ridge is located to the southwest of Honeydew Village in northeastern Jade Forest. To the southeast begins the Ascent of Swirling Winds.
Sea Monarchs are giant carp swimming around Lonesome Cove in the Dread Wastes. __NOTOC__

Scrying stones are devices that were created by the Highborne which can be used to communicate across distances. They appear to enable two-way visual and audio communication between whoever is using them.

Scruff is a rare boar found wandering just north of Shady Rest Inn in Dustwallow Marsh.

Sea Scorpions are caught in the seas around for those with fishing skill under ~700. Players will rarely catch them with fishing skill above 800. Gutting them produced a random amount of Sea Scorpion Segment. This can also be down automatically while fishing if Bladebone Hook has been applied.

The Scrolls of the Celestials are a collection of tales detailing the history of the August Celestials and their roles in aiding the pandaren, who were subjugated by the mogu empire. These scrolls were found by Fenella Darkvire and her mining team, left forgotten in an ancient sanctum used to worship the Celestials in secret during the brutal reign of the mogu. Fendrig Redbeard read a translated version aloud to the team before they left the underground sanctum.
Scroll of Touch of Death is the monk class tome found in Ashran.
Scroll of Risky Recall is a consumable item found as a random zone drop in Ashran.
Scroll of Replenishment was a consumable item found as a random zone drop in Ashran.
Scroll of Storytelling applies a sepia filter to the screen, making it look like an old-timey photograph.
This item can be fenced to Griftah using the Secretive Whistle for Dingy Iron Coins.
The Sea-kissed Scroll can be found next to the corpse of Trogra at a small hut in the southern part of Zorammarsh, Tanaan Jungle. It tells the tale of Captain Ironbeard.
